questions.question: In fiscal year 2024, what was the total Medicaid spending for California in millions of dollars?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('macpac_medicaid_spending_by_state_fy2024.xlsx', sheet_name='Exhibit 16', header=None)
ca_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'California']
result = float(ca_row.iloc[0, 7])

questions.question: Which three states had the highest total Medicaid expenditures in fiscal year 2024?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('macpac_medicaid_spending_by_state_fy2024.xlsx', sheet_name='Exhibit 16', header=None)
# States are between row index 4 (Alabama) and 54 (Wyoming)
states_df = df.iloc[4:55].copy()
states_df[7] = pd.to_numeric(states_df[7])
top3 = states_df.sort_values(by=7, ascending=False).head(3)
result = top3[0].str.strip().tolist()

questions.question: Between Florida and Ohio, which state spent more on Medicaid benefits from federal funds in FY 2024?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('macpac_medicaid_spending_by_state_fy2024.xlsx', sheet_name='Exhibit 16', header=None)
fl_val = float(df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Florida'].iloc[0, 2])
oh_val = float(df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Ohio'].iloc[0, 2])
result = 'Florida' if fl_val > oh_val else 'Ohio'

questions.question: How many states (including the District of Columbia) had total Medicaid spending of at least $20,000 million in FY 2024?

states_df[7] = pd.to_numeric(states_df[7])
result = int((states_df[7] >= 20000).sum())

questions.question: In fiscal year 2024, what was the combined total Medicaid spending across the five US territories in millions of dollars?

questions.question: Did federal funds account for more than half of Wyoming's total Medicaid spending in FY 2024?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('macpac_medicaid_spending_by_state_fy2024.xlsx', sheet_name='Exhibit 16', header=None)
wy = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Wyoming'].iloc[0]
total = float(wy[7])
federal = float(wy[9])
result = 'yes' if (federal / total) > 0.5 else 'no'
